intro: Ezra chair makes dining feel effortless and warm. Its soft seat, supportive back, and sturdy base with optional swivel let you choose steady comfort or easy motion for every shared moment.

features.title: Plush comfort for everyday meals
features.text: Cushioned seat and backrest keep you at ease from morning breakfasts to late-night talks, making every sit inviting and relaxing.

features.title: Curved backrest that supports posture
features.text: The ergonomic shape hugs your spine, ensuring natural alignment so you can enjoy longer meals without feeling strained.

features.title: Diverse leg base options to suit your needs
features.text: Keep it steady for classic dining or opt for swivel when you want flexible, fluid movement without shifting your chair.

features.title: Toffee finish with timeless charm
features.text: The rich brown tone warms up your dining space, blending easily with modern or traditional interiors for a welcoming touch.

specs: Size (W x H x D, cm)
